topic: Lidar camera analysis and installation permission
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on reviewing video footage from a lidar setup, specifically addressing visibility across multiple lanes (up to 5 in both directions) and minor screen visibility issues. After the analysis of the video, someone requested permission for remaining installations.
decisions: Video footage was reviewed showing full lane coverage in both directions.
action_items: Someone needs to provide a video demonstrating the setup (syncing with capturing on Jetson).
Permission is requested for remaining installations following video analysis.
